summary: Iteration-3 features verified end-to-end. Backend: 76/81 pytest pass (94%) — all NEW iter-3 endpoints green (service-requests CRUD+status, admin reviews list/flag/delete+rating recompute, admin categories CRUD with delete-blocked-when-used, admin cities incl. public featured filter, admin audit-log with admin enrichment, admin PATCH provider). Twilio log-only mode confirmed: db.sms_log entries created with status='log_only' for ALL 5 events (new_message_to_provider, message_reply, new_quote_request, request_accepted, verify_approved). Frontend: dark Admin Console at /admin loads with proper sidebar (Resumen/Cola/Proveedores/Reseñas/Categorías/Audit), all 5 sub-pages render with data; anonymous /admin correctly redirects to /login; /buscar and /proveedor/:slug aliases work. ONE NEW CRITICAL REGRESSION: PUT /api/users/me returns 404 — the update_user function at server.py:985 is orphaned (no @api_router.put decorator), placed AFTER the '# ============ INCLUDE ROUTER ============' separator. This breaks /users/me profile updates from any UI (e.g., Mi Perfil page) and is the root cause of iter2 TestUserUpdate failures.

critical.issue: Returns 404 — update_user() at server.py:985 has NO @api_router.put('/users/me') decorator. It is defined as a bare async function AFTER the '# INCLUDE ROUTER' comment and never registered. Regression introduced in iter-3 rewrite. Fix: add `@api_router.put("/users/me")` immediately above the function (line 984) and move it BEFORE the include_router call.

minor.issue: Demo provider gallery still empty (carryover from iter-3). server.py demo seed block still gated by db.users.find_one(demo email); on existing DB the new gallery insert is never executed. iteration3_test::TestDemoGallery still failing.

iteration1 TestReviews::test_create_review_and_duplicate_rejected fails (rating_count==2, expected 1) — likely flakiness from accumulated demo reviews or missing per-(user,provider) uniqueness on reviews.
RegisterIn does not accept `phone` (only email/password/name/role). To populate User.phone (needed for SMS), users must update via PUT /users/me — which is currently broken (see CRITICAL).

integration_issues.issue: 2 AxiosError page errors observed during admin navigation (non-blocking — pages still render). Likely caused by occasional 4xx from background fetches.

action_items: [CRITICAL] Add `@api_router.put("/users/me")` decorator above update_user() at server.py:985 — it currently sits below '# INCLUDE ROUTER' separator and is unregistered. This breaks the user profile edit flow.
Move update_user() back to its proper location near other user/auth endpoints (before include_router) for clarity.
(Carryover iter-3) Make demo provider gallery seed idempotent — split user-existence and provider_profile gallery checks; OR run one-shot migration to $set gallery items on existing demo profile.
(Carryover iter-2) Add `phone` field to RegisterIn so newly registered users can opt-in to SMS without needing PUT /users/me.
Add a per-(user_id, provider_id) uniqueness check on POST /api/reviews to prevent duplicate reviews from same user.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:985 — update_user() is unreachable (missing decorator). Code review must verify route registration after every endpoint move.
server.py is ~1200 lines — should be split (auth.py, providers.py, messaging.py, admin.py, sms.py, storage.py).

send_sms() depends on User.phone being set; RegisterIn does not expose phone and PUT /users/me is broken — so in practice ALL SMS events for client-side users currently no-op unless DB is mutated externally. Worth surfacing this UX gap.
Admin audit log writes are scattered across endpoints with copy-pasted insert blocks — extract a `_log_audit(admin_id, action, target, note)` helper.
No rate-limiting on POST /api/service-requests or POST /api/messages — bots could spam providers.
ServiceRequestStatusIn uses Literal enum correctly; CategoryIn lacks color/icon format validation.

rca_of_issue: PUT /api/users/me 404: The endpoint handler `update_user()` exists in server.py at line 985, but it sits inside/after the comment block `# ============ INCLUDE ROUTER ============` and has NO `@api_router.put(...)` decorator. Compare to other user/auth endpoints (lines 463-541) which all properly use @api_router.<method>. Reproduction: `curl -X PUT $BACKEND/api/users/me -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{"name":"x"}'` returns 404 Not Found. Mitigation: prepend `@api_router.put("/users/me")` to line 984 and (ideally) relocate the function above the include_router call so it follows the same pattern as siblings. Once fixed, 3 existing tests will pass and the Mi Perfil flow will be unblocked.
